brief: Yayoi Kusama's death marks the end of a prolific artistic era, while Nepal's flash floods highlight ongoing regional crises. In tech, research on Discord gaming communities and color perception studies offer fresh insights into human-computer interaction.
news_summary: Japanese artist Yayoi Kusama dies at 97; Nepal flash floods claim hundreds with many missing. US politics, school costs, and royal family news also feature.
papers_summary: Papers explore Discord's role in teen gaming, stretchable interconnects for dual sensing, and replication of color discrimination studies, enhancing understanding of interactive systems.

zh.brief: 今日焦点为中尼边境山洪造成的重大伤亡，以及Meta儿童安全诉讼的巨额和解；同时，草间弥生和多莉·帕顿的逝世引发文化回响。
zh.news_summary: 中尼边境山洪已致逾160人死亡，上千人失踪，救援持续；Meta就社交平台儿童安全诉讼达成180亿美元和解，或推动更严格监管。

todays_image.caption: The polka dots that once adorned an anonymous vintage dress now echo the infinite, whimsical pattern that defined Yayoi Kusama's luminous vision.
todays_image.title: The Polka Dot Dress
